notes: Added 5 stories for FIND-P-M1 covering schema, core logic, facade/API, integration, and tests.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for provider search inputs/outputs
Added core logic story for vector + taxonomy search
Added integration story with specialty + embeddings
Added unit and integration test suite

stories.title: Define Provider Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty) and outputs (provider list, scores, metadata) ensuring compatibility with tool_router and facade usage.

stories.title: Implement Vector + Taxonomy Provider Search Logic
stories.description: Implement provider search using MongoDB Atlas vector search with fallback to NUCC taxonomy matching, including geo filtering and ranking logic.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCareFacade
stories.description: Integrate provider search service into FindCareFacade and expose as callable tool for the agent loop, ensuring proper request/response mapping.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Identification and Embedding Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate specialty_service for NUCC mapping and embedding_client for query vectorization to support hybrid search pipeline.

stories.title: Provider Search Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for search logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from tool_router through facade to provider search results.
